name: sg-recorder
description: Recording engine extracted unchanged from the video-recorder tool (v0.1.48–v0.1.63 overlays): 9 capture modes, per-track MediaRecorders, canvas compositors (PiP / Shorts / Infographic), camera warm-up, WebM duration fix. Event contract (SGA_RECORDER, tool:* window events) is frozen — consumers include the video-recorder and video-publisher tools.
note: Pure engine, no DOM ownership beyond canvases/streams it creates. Depends on core/sg-capture v0.1.1 and core/sg-video-recorder v0.1.2. recorder-pipeline.js exposes module-level singletons (config, state) — one recorder per page.
